items.name: Post-Lockdown Fest Tunisia 2020

venue.name: [Moez's house]
venue.details: The competition will be held in the outdoors. The competitors will be solving in a 6*12 m^2 area and have enough space.

items.information:
Post-Quarantine Fest Tunisia is open for participants from all countries. Everyone is welcome as long as we are safe.

*  Every competitor must have an idea about the regulations, specifically the WCA Safety Policy. 
*  Sandwiches will be available for lunch included in the registration fee.
*  No more than one guest per competitor. 
_____
Post-Quarantine Fest Tunisia est ouverte pour tout participants. Tout le monde est le bienvenue tant qu'on est tous saufes.

*  Chaque competiteur doit avoir une idée du règlement, en particulier de la politique de sécurité WCA.
*   Des sandwichs seront disponibles pour le déjeuner, inclus dans les frais d'inscription.
*  Pas plus d'un accompagnateur par competiteur.

items.information:
Tunisia Autumn Open 2016 is open for participants from all countries, everyone is welcome.

To get to the venue, you can either take the train up to "Les Hotels" stop, it's a 20 minute walk from that station.
You can take the bus, number 52A from the central station in Monastir or Sousse. This bus stops just in front of the hotel.
You can go by car, follow the highway linking Monastir and Sousse.

It should be known that only competitors who do check-in into the hotel can benefit from the lunch.
Medals and Gifts will be awarded to the winners in each category.
Competition fee is 10dt per participant
